sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wppost-block directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
sections.faq:
Is this plugin has slider support?

Currently we are not adding slider.

Can I add responsive design?

Yes, you can add responsive design.
